Data Privacy Notice

i-KONEK • Antipolo City Health Office

The Antipolo City Health Office is committed to protecting personal information processed through the i-KONEK system in accordance with Republic Act No. 10173, or the Data Privacy Act of 2012, its Implementing Rules and Regulations, and applicable issuances.

Why information is processed

Personal and health-related information submitted through this system may be processed for legitimate public health functions, including heat-related illness surveillance, case monitoring, referral and follow-up, prevention activities, and preparation of public health statistics and reports.

Confidentiality and access

Information that identifies an individual is intended for authorized personnel who need it for their official duties. Public dashboard information should be presented in aggregate form and should not expose patient names, contact details, addresses, or individual medical records.

Sharing and security

Information may be shared only when necessary for a lawful and legitimate public health purpose, with appropriate authority and safeguards. Reasonable organizational, physical, and technical measures should be used to protect information against unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, loss, or misuse.

Your privacy rights

Data subjects may exercise their rights under the Data Privacy Act, subject to applicable legal conditions and limitations. For privacy-related questions or requests, contact the designated Data Protection Officer (DPO) or authorized privacy representative of the Antipolo City Health Office.

Reminder: Please do not submit another person's personal or medical information unless you are authorized to do so and the information is necessary for the stated public health purpose.

Legal reference: Republic Act No. 10173 – Data Privacy Act of 2012.

iPhone / iPad — Save this App

Android App

I-download ang i-KONEK application para sa Android device.

Walang kailangang i-install na Android APK sa iPhone/iPad. Para madaling balikan ang i-KONEK dashboard, gamitin ang Safari at idagdag ito sa Home Screen o Bookmark.

1
Buksan gamit ang SafariOpen the i-KONEK website in Safari sa iPhone o iPad.
2
Pindutin ang ShareI-tap ang Share icon (square na may arrow) sa Safari toolbar.
3
Piliin ang “Add to Home Screen”Magkakaroon ng shortcut sa Home Screen na parang app.
4
Optional: Add BookmarkPwede ring piliin ang “Add Bookmark” para ma-save sa Safari bookmarks.
Tip: Mas convenient ang Add to Home Screen para one-tap access sa dashboard nang walang Android APK.

User Access

Barangay Management

Unit number is generated automatically. Adding a unit also creates its 5 blank duty-shift rows.

Driver On Duty
